name.jp: シャルロット・コルデー

periods.species: human (not a Blazer in this passage)

status.current: attends the banquet as Rinna's servant, not as a tournament representative

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Mistress; Charlotte translates Rinna's theatrical speech into ordinary meaning.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Carries Sara away after Shizuku knocks her out.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Politely greets him but becomes jealous when Rinna talks about hiring him.

periods.summary: Charlotte accompanies Rinna at the banquet and clarifies that she is Rinna's personal maid rather than a representative student. She translates Rinna's exaggerated declarations into plain language, carries the unconscious Sara away, and shows subtle jealousy when Rinna tries to recruit Ikki as a butler.

key_events.summary: Introduces herself and removes Sara from the hall.

periods.label: 大小姐的剑与盾

name.jp: シャルロット・コルデー

periods.species: human / non-Blazer empowered by Servant Collar

status.current: defeated by Stella's second Dragon King Flame while protecting Rinna

personality.summary: Polite, expressionless and absolutely devoted; her whole identity is to serve Rinna as sword, shield and even pet if required.
values: standing between her master and danger

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Beloved mistress who once saved her from the garbage; Charlotte lives to be her sword and shield.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Opponent who respects her loyalty but proves she cannot protect Rinna against repeated ultimate flames.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Kurono intercepts stray shield projectiles to protect spectators.

periods.summary: Charlotte enters Stella's match from the audience, but the referee allows it because Rinna's Servant Collar makes her an extension of Rinna's Blazer ability. Under the collar she manifests shield flowers that can block Stella's greatsword, form blades, provide aerial footing, act as thrown weapons, and insulate against Stella's flames. Her Thousand-Petal Shield withstands Stella's first Dragon King Flame through sheer loyalty and Rinna's trust, but Stella can immediately fire the technique again. Charlotte's shield and body reach their limit, and she falls with Rinna after fulfilling her role as protector as long as possible.

key_events.summary: Reveals herself as Rinna's true trump card and battles Stella as shield specialist.

periods.label: 忠犬女仆解说幻想讽画败因

name.jp: シャルロット・コルデー

status.current: watching Sara's match with Rinna and Stella
status.condition: guilt-ridden and possessive after failing to protect Rinna in the first round

personality.summary: Cold and competent on the surface, but masochistically devoted and jealous regarding Rinna.

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Mistress whom Charlotte worships and feels she failed to protect.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Former opponent; Charlotte resents Stella's closeness to Rinna but explains combat details after Sara loses.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Akatsuki-side ally whose Fantasia Art she analyzes.

periods.summary: Charlotte accompanies Rinna to watch Sara's match. Rinna reveals Charlotte has been demanding punishment because she failed to protect her in the prior defeat, and Charlotte reacts jealously when Stella gets too close to Rinna. After Ikki beats Sara, Charlotte explains the technical reason: Sara's fake Edelweiss can reproduce power but only follows a drawn victory composition, and Ikki exploited the one-sword first-strike advantage against dual swords at the decisive instant.

key_events.summary: Provides Akatsuki-side analysis of why Ikki defeated Sara's copied Edelweiss.
